intent: Sum today's availability of the Hansgrohe Compact Logis 1ZN-TEP shower-waste 50mm Drain Trap and Siphon across every Graz store, including zero-availability branches.
success_criteria: Exactly one product variant resolved: brand Hansgrohe, series Compact Logis, model 1ZN-TEP, trap_type 'shower waste', diameter_mm 50
Every Graz store enumerated via LEFT JOIN so branches with 0 / missing store_inventory rows are counted as 0, not dropped
Total = SUM(COALESCE(available_today_quantity,0)) over all Graz stores for that SKU
Answer string matches the exact form 'qty %d'
refs contain the record_path of EVERY Graz store plus the product variant record_path

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties tt ON tt.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND tt.property_key = 'trap_type' AND tt.property_value_text = :trap_type JOIN product_variant_properties dm ON dm.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND dm.property_key = 'diameter_mm' AND dm.property_value_number = :diameter_mm WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model;

WITH prod AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties tt ON tt.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND tt.property_key = 'trap_type' AND tt.property_value_text = :trap_type JOIN product_variant_properties dm ON dm.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND dm.property_key = 'diameter_mm' AND dm.property_value_number = :diameter_mm WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model) SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path AS store_path, p.product_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today, (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(si2.available_today_quantity,0)) FROM stores s2 CROSS JOIN prod p2 LEFT JOIN store_inventory si2 ON si2.store_id = s2.store_id AND si2.product_sku = p2.product_sku WHERE s2.city = :city) AS total_available FROM stores s CROSS JOIN prod p LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = p.product_sku WHERE s.city = :city ORDER BY s.store_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.

answer_template.message: qty {total_available} — Hansgrohe Compact Logis 1ZN-TEP shower-waste 50mm Drain Trap and Siphon, summed across all {graz_store_count} Graz PowerTool branches (zero-availability branches included).
